evidence.quote: It handles columnar queries 15x faster than our current setup.

observations.why: Supplying a comparative performance fact to justify the adoption decision — informational control paired with a logic-based argument.
Categorizing and labeling the decision as a settled fact — controlling the informational frame by asserting the database choice as established.
Quantitative evidence marshalled as a logical argument for the adoption — a performance metric presented as justification.
Stating a timeline as a settled fact — controlling the informational frame by asserting a schedule without consultation or hedging.
